📚 Today you learned

Backlog / RPO (Remaining Performance Obligation)

Backlog — also called RPO, Remaining Performance Obligation — is contracted revenue a company has already signed but hasn't billed or delivered yet. For subscription and cloud businesses it's the cleanest forward-revenue signal there is, because it's contractual, not a forecast analysts can be wrong about. GOOG just reported cloud backlog near $514B alongside 82% YoY cloud revenue growth — which is exactly why the Aug 11 report got called "strong Q2 results" in the same breath as a 3.6% stock drop: the fundamentals were genuinely good, the selloff was about how the $205B 2026 capex guide is getting financed ($25B new debt, $40B in fresh equity issuance), not about demand. Watch backlog's growth *rate* over time, not the headline number — decelerating backlog growth is usually the first crack in a capex supercycle story, well before revenue shows it.

Also today: debt-funded AI capex — hyperscalers increasingly financing data-center buildouts with debt and share issuance rather than pure free cash flow, a leverage-up signal worth tracking across the whole cohort (ties to Day 11's hyperscaler capex concept).
